title: Tidemark Capital — DealLedger Legacy LP Migration, Multi-Currency Wires & Portal Invite Escalation
fund: Tidemark Capital legacy LP base (DealLedger migration)
initialRequestBrief: Tidemark Capital is migrating 650 legacy LP entities from DealLedger CRM ahead of Q1 Capital Call & Tax distributions. Multi-currency EUR/JPY wires are failing validation and institutional bank LPs at Cityline/Rhone Union report missing portal invite emails.

contextTags.Issue: Missing Portal Invites at Bank-Hosted Mailboxes

comparisonResults.howPastCaseWent: 3,200 K-1 notices sent in one burst through an unaligned email identity were quarantined at bank gateways and dormant LPs hit 412 MFA lockouts; aligned DKIM, throttling, a bank IT whitelisting guide and a pre-flight runbook fixed it.
pitfallWarnings: No bounces plus no delivery at bank-hosted mailboxes usually means quarantine; check DKIM alignment first.
Re-verify dormant LPs' contacts and MFA two weeks before any tax distribution.

deltaItems.pastApproach: Guide for bank IT teams: allow-list on the authenticated domain when DMARC passes, verification test, seasonal volumes.
deltaItems.currentRequirement: Cityline- and Rhone Union-hosted LPs not receiving portal invites.
deltaItems.actionRecommendation: Confirm DKIM alignment on Tidemark's sending identity, then send the guide to the affected banks' IT contacts and run the two-address test.

deltaItems.pastApproach: T-14 re-verification campaign, throttled publish at 200/min, lockout handling script.
deltaItems.currentRequirement: Q1 tax distributions with 118 dormant LP users pending MFA enrolment.
deltaItems.actionRecommendation: Schedule the runbook's T-21 to T+3 timeline against Tidemark's Q1 tax distribution date.

comparisonResults.howPastCaseWent: JPY and EUR wires were falsely flagged as underfunded because spot FX moved between instruction and settlement; a GP-adopted ±0.25% tolerance with a true-up ledger and a dual-currency notice fixed it.
pitfallWarnings: The GP must adopt the tolerance under an LPA clause; the administrator cannot waive unpaid capital.
Keep the band far below the smallest genuine shortfall.

deltaItems.category: FX settlement tolerance for EUR/JPY wires
deltaItems.pastApproach: ±0.25% of the amount called, true-up on the next call, reminders suppressed only within the band.
deltaItems.currentRequirement: EUR and JPY wires off by 0.02-0.11%; USD wires short by intermediary fees.
deltaItems.actionRecommendation: Check Tidemark's LPA for a de minimis clause equivalent to Section 3.4(e), then have the GP adopt the ±0.25% policy before the Q1 call.

deltaItems.pastApproach: Notice with indicative JPY/EUR amount, printed band, intermediary routing table and OUR charges instruction.
deltaItems.currentRequirement: Q1 capital call to the migrated LP base.
deltaItems.actionRecommendation: Issue the Q1 call on the dual-currency template to cut fee-driven shortfalls.

comparisonResults.howPastCaseWent: A 400-LP legacy Excel register broke Relata import on multi-trustee family trusts, and concurrent pension subscriptions nearly breached the ERISA 25% aggregate cap; a trust normalization template, BPI-aware mapping and a cap guard fixed both.
pitfallWarnings: Trusts split one row per trustee double-count commitments; dedupe on name, instrument date and TIN last 4.

deltaItems.pastApproach: Normalization template and Relata CRM field map: one row per trust, trustees as signatories, dedupe key.
deltaItems.currentRequirement: 650 legacy LP entities from DealLedger CRM, with duplicated trusts, concatenated trustee names and custodial IRAs.
deltaItems.actionRecommendation: Reuse the normalization template as-is, but rebuild the CRM field map for DealLedger's entity and contact model (Relata → DealLedger), adding custodial IRA handling.

deltaItems.pastApproach: Template that collapsed 29 duplicate trustee rows and sent 8 to IR for confirmation.
deltaItems.currentRequirement: 38 duplicated trusts and 21 concatenated trustee names in the DealLedger export.
deltaItems.actionRecommendation: Run the DealLedger export through the template before any capital call preview is generated.

artifacts.description: Exceptions found in Tidemark's DealLedger migration: duplicated and concatenated trusts, custodial IRAs, EUR/JPY wire validation failures and missing portal invites at bank-hosted mailboxes.
